decisions: Actual Tooltip portal positioning, collision handling and defaults remain primitive-owned; CSS does not recreate anchor coordinates. Native radius/insets are adopted as semantic popup metrics, while width is fluid with an explicit bounded maximum. Tooltip uses native 8px corners and 8/12px insets, inverse foreground/background colors, and its actual internal Arrow class. The chosen usage hides duplicate visual tooltip text from accessibility and provides essential help persistently with a real aria-describedby relation; this is an explicit accessible usage, not a claim the pinned source automatically creates that relation.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
